title: Internal: Credit Card Retention Protocol
summary: This document defines the “Credit Card Retention Protocol” (Rho-Bank) for customers requesting account closure. It requires eligibility checks (no pending disputes, no pending replacement cards, 60+ days open, zero outstanding balance), runs get_closure_reason_history_8293 for prior reasons in the past year, logs closure reasons via log_credit_card_closure_reason_4521, offers tier-based retention (500/2,000/5,000 points or $5/$20/$50), then outlines closure steps and rewards timing (45 days) and annual fee refund window (refund if closed within 37 days).
faqs: What eligibility requirements must be met before I can attempt credit card retention or close the account?
How does the protocol handle previous closure reason attempts in the past year?
What closure reasons are allowed, and how are they logged (tool log_credit_card_closure_reason_4521)?
If my reason is annual fee, what options are offered (waive annual fee for one year vs permanent downgrade)?
If I still want to close after concerns, what retention offer do I get by card tier (entry/mid/premium)?
After submitting a closure request, how long do I have to redeem unredeemed rewards, and when is an annual fee refund available?
keywords: 37 days annual fee full refund window
Entry-tier retention: 500 bonus points or $5 statement credit
Mid-tier retention: 2,000 bonus points or $20 statement credit
Premium+ retention: 5,000 bonus points or $50 statement credit
